Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
I'm not necessarily good w accurately gauging the power-curve, but here are my immediate thoughts:

*Ecaterina the Wise

Looks v g & strong, maybe a bit too strong so need to drop the +1 stealth bit

*Synner-G

Similarly, i'd play him in any weenie OBF deck just with the first part of the caption. Maybe drop the 2nd sentence

*Falstaff

Looks great. V g idea w BH & Research tech

*El Diablo Verde

General caption is a great idea. Not sure about the overall minion tho. A 3-cap w POT seems pretty good by itself. A minion w an inbuilt Immortal Grapple is awesome. Rolling it all into 1 seems a bit much tho. Maybe either make it a 4-5 cap, or redesign the cap/disc's of the minion & then add the caption. Maybe give leave it as a 3-cap !Nos, but give it ANI or OBF instead.
Maybe add a negative caption to balance also

*Soeur Jeanne

Seems great. A little tech to shaft infernal & especially Bahari is welcome.

*Naomi McKellar

Seems great. Interesting caption

*Lord Marcus

Generally good, but for a 9-cap the Discipline combo is odd; and the 2 sentence abt Path of Night is waaay too strong. Maybe better to drop the 2nd sentence (or just keep 1 buff, eg: the +1 str) & bring up the disc's to include POT (tho it's hard to ignore how good any 9-cap is w DOM!)

*Josephine the Seamstress of Flesh

Seems great, tho a bit too strong for a 4-cap. Maybe make her a 5-cap?

Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Ecaterina the Wise
> Brujah Antitribu
> Cap 9
>
> Sabbat Bishop
> +1 stealth agains Camarilla vampires. Ecaterina may burn two blood to call a referendum requiring a Camarilla Prince.
>
Interesting vampire. Why not an Archbishop?
Her first special needs to be reworded. Probably should be "Camarilla vampires get -1 intercept when attempting to block Ecaterina". In her second special, the word "Camarilla" is redundant.
I think overall she's slightly overcost. Her second special is interesting but, in a deck built using those votes, she'd either be the only vampire you have able to call them, or she'd be worse at calling them than your other vampires. So not as powerful a special as it first seems.

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Synner-G
> Gangrel Antitribu
> Cap 3
>
> Sabbat
> Synner-G untaps if he successfully equips with a Laptop Computer. He also gets +1 stealth while bleeding with Computer Hacking and/or Laptop Computer
>
Too cheap. I'd give him one or the other of those specials, not both.

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Falstaff
> Malkavian Antitribu
> Cap 8
>
> Sabbat. Black Hand. Falstaff may enter combat with any younger non-Black Hand Vampire. During combat he may play any card from your research area, as it was from your hand.
>
With the currently existing research tech, he's severely underpowered. If that situation changes, he's probably still about 1 point short of where he should be.

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> El Diablo Verde
> Nosferatu Antitribu
> Cap 3
>
> Sabbat. At close range, El Diabo Verde and the opposing minion may only make hand strikes.
>
Far too strong. A 3 cap with  is already a very good (but balanced) vampire. With his special he should either be higher capacity, or have a crippling disadvantage.

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Soeur Jeanne
> Toreador Antitribu
> Cap 7
>
> Sabbat. +1 bleed against infernal. +1 bleed against Bahari
>
Not worth 7 cap, should be 6. Her first bonus is conditional on a very rare trait, her second on a trait that can only be given by someone to their own vampires and no-one in the game starts with.
Also, her text should be reworded, assuming you want her abilities to stack it should read "Soeur Jeanne gets +1 bleed when bleeding a Methuselah who controls a ready infernal minion, and an additional +1 bleed when bleeding a Methuselah who controls a ready Bahari."

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Naomi McKellar
> Ventrue Antitribu
> Cap 7
>
> Sabbat Once during your untap phase, you may move the top card of any other meths. library to your research area.
>
Seems balanced. Would be interesting in a Harbringers mill deck (2 of their G6 have  / ).

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Lord Marcus
> Lasombra
> Cap 9
>
> Sabbat. Obtenbration cards cost Lord Marcus 1 less blood. If Path of Night is in play Lord Marcus gets +1 bleed, +1 stealth, +1 intercept and +1 strength
>
His second special is probably too powerful to put on a 9 cap vampire. I know his discipline spread is hideously low to balance this, but I don't think it works overall.

> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Josephine the Seamstress of Flesh
> Tzimisce
> Cap 4
>
> Sabbat Josephine may play any  Vicissitude card from your research area as it was from your hand
>
As it stands, this is balanced. It depends on whether the designers intend for many more uses of the research area. I would probably suggest a minor disadvantage (eg a penalty against a specific clan).

Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
Synner-G:
Consider with a single (zero cost) card, he can bleed for 2 at 1 stealth. Or with a laptop he can do that without ever playing any other cards. On a 3 cap. That's easily worth a single discipline point.
The fact that the one point he does have is  just makes it even better.
His untap special is probably worth about a half point.

El Diablo Verde:
A suitable drawback might be one of the below;
El Diablo Verde cannot have or use equipment.
El Diablo Verde cannot use ranged strikes.
-1 stealth.
I can think of others, but I think these best fit the idea of a pro-wrestler vampire, and still leave him very usable.

Naomi McKellar:
Depending on the type of spy she was, presence might be more appropriate. As a card I think obfuscate works better.

Falstaff:
Even with your Art of War card, I still think he's underpowered. At a simple numbers game you're pricing his research area special at about 1.5 - 2 points. Additionally, his disciplines don't work well with either of his specials. Superior  would fix that, or basic of an additional combat discipline and your Art of War card.
